description: Where one ship has been, by MMSI: her positions oldest first, over the last hours (1 to 168) or between two times within the last 90 days (at most 14 days). Each point is a time, latitude, longitude, speed and course, as columns names them. Shiptrail hears ships from receivers near coasts, so open sea shows as gaps; positions are kept where she turned or every few minutes, not every report.

from.description: The window's start, within the last 90 days.

hours.description: The last this many hours. Or give from and to instead.

mmsi.description: Her MMSI: the whole nine-digit number, not part of it (find it with search_ships).

to.description: The window's end; now when left out. At most 14 days after from.

name: get_track

columns.description: What each point holds, in order: at, lat, lon, speedKn, courseDeg (null where not reported).

from.description: The window's start, to the minute.

thinned.description: Present when the window held more points than one answer carries: these were chosen evenly, her first and last among them.

to.description: The window's end, to the minute.

url.description: Her page, or the port's, on shiptrail.io.

title: A ship's track
